lines.en: label utaspring6:
scene sky
The air had changed in Kumon-mi lately.
lines.zh: 最近，Kumon-mi 的空气变了。

lines.en: {i}Whoosh.{/i}
And it wasn’t just because there were arrows suddenly cutting through it.
lines.zh: 而这不仅仅是因为突然有箭划破了它。

lines.en: It was because-
lines.zh: 是因为——

lines.en: {i}Whoosh.{/i}
It-
lines.zh: 它是——

lines.en: {i}Whoosh.{/i}
Okay, we get it.
lines.zh: 好了，我们懂了。

lines.en: Anyway, if the sound effects or the mention of arrows didn’t do enough to inform you that today’s scene takes place at the archery range, allow the following CG to attempt to do the same.
lines.zh: 总之，如果音效和“箭”这个字眼还不足以让你明白今天的场景发生在射箭场，那就让下面这张 CG 再来试试吧。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk1

And if that still doesn’t do it for you, you should probably just exit the game now since your skills in both listening and reading comprehension make me seriously doubt your ability to understand anything at all.
lines.zh: 如果这样你还是没搞懂，那你现在大概就该退出游戏了，因为你的听力和阅读理解能力让我严重怀疑你理解任何东西的能力。

lines.en: If you’re still here, though, hello. I am too — serving as a celestial chaperone for two girls currently murdering a target with pointy sticks on a coldish but also slightly warm spring day.
lines.zh: 不过如果你还在这儿，那你好。我也在——担任两位女生的天界监护人，她们正用一个凉中带暖的春日、拿着尖尖的棍子把靶子往死里射。

lines.en: If that one didn’t make any sense, it’s not your fault. But I digress and I return to what I said just moments ago about the air here changing.
lines.zh: 要是这句没听懂，那不是你的错。不过我扯远了，回到我刚才说的这儿的空气正在改变。

lines.en: Now that a celebrity had laid claim to the heart of Akira Arakawa, those still competing for a piece of it were doing all they could just to catch up.
lines.zh: 既然一位名人已经对 Akira Arakawa 的心宣示了主权，那些还在争夺其中一块的人，正使出浑身解数只为追上来。

lines.en: For some, that meant fucking with their hair or their makeup or wardrobe.
lines.zh: 对有些人来说，那意味着折腾头发、妆容或者衣服。

lines.en: But for others, it meant training to-
lines.zh: 但对另一些人来说，那意味着训练去——

lines.en: : Murder...
lines.zh: : 谋杀……

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk2
: Are you going to say that every single time you shoot? Because, as an attorney, you should probably know that isn’t going to make your case easy to defend in court.
lines.zh: : 你每次射箭都要说一遍吗？因为作为一名律师，你大概该知道，这会让你的案子在法庭上不好辩护。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk3
: We do what we must do for love. Even if it means to {i}kill.{/i}
lines.zh: : 为了爱，我们做我们必须做的事。哪怕那意味着{i}杀人{/i}。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk4
: See that target, Io? That target is pop music. And this arrow? This arrow is a career-ending scandal.
lines.zh: : 看见那个靶子了吗，Io？那个靶子就是流行音乐。而这支箭呢？这支箭就是一场终结职业生涯的丑闻。

lines.en: : You don’t have an arrow. You forgot to grab a new one.
lines.zh: : 你没有箭。你忘了拿新的。

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: : Also, I’m not sure a “career ending scandal” is going to do much good at all when the girl you’re thinking about murdering sort of manufactured her own scandal. Let your arrows be apathy or something.
lines.zh: : 还有，我不确定“终结职业生涯的丑闻”能有多大用，毕竟你想杀的那个女孩某种程度上是自己制造了自己的丑闻。让你的箭变成“漠不关心”之类的吧。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk5
: Ooh. That sounded kind of good. Maybe I can make Sensei like me more if I start writing poetry? I’m pretty sure that’s what Ami did.
lines.zh: : 哦。听起来还挺不错的。也许我要是开始写诗，Sensei 就会更喜欢我？我敢说 Ami 就是这么干的。

lines.en: : I just don’t get it, Io! Not even the top five have a shot now that Niki Nakayama is openly claiming him!
lines.zh: : 我就是不明白啊，Io！既然 Niki Nakayama 已经公开宣称他是她的了，前五名都没戏了！

lines.en: : We’re gonna need to do {i}way{/i} more than just poetry or murder if we want a shot at catching up. We’re gonna need to do something {i}crazy.{/i}
lines.zh: : 如果我们想追上去，光靠写诗或者杀人可{i}远远{/i}不够。我们得做点{i}疯狂{/i}的事。

lines.en: : Is murder not crazy anymore?
lines.zh: : 杀人已经不算疯狂了吗？

lines.en: : Murder’s old news. I’m like one step away from taking Noriko up on her boombox idea.
lines.zh: : 杀人都是旧闻了。我离采纳 Noriko 那个手提音响的点子就差一步了。

lines.en: : Hey, if you really want to earn some points, just jerk him off. That’s what I did and I think it went pretty well. I might have even jumped a spot or two in the rankings.
lines.zh: : 嘿，要是你真想刷点分，就帮他打一发呗。我就是这么干的，而且我觉得效果相当不错。我搞不好还在排行榜上跳了一两名。

lines.en: : Yes, well not everyone is-
lines.zh: : 是，嗯，可也不是谁都——

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk6
: Wait, you did {i}what?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 等等，你干了{i}什么？！{/i}

lines.en: : How’d your bow still make that noise without an arrow?
lines.zh: : 没有箭，你的弓怎么还能发出那个声音？

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk7
: {i}Io!{/i} You didn’t. {i}You?{/i} The no-sex girl? You did hand-sex?!
lines.zh: : {i}Io！{/i}你不会吧。{i}你？{/i}那个禁欲女孩？你做了用手的性行为？！

lines.en: : I guess. But if you ever want any chance of doing that as well, you probably shouldn’t call it “hand-sex.”
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过你要是也想有朝一日做同样的事，最好别管它叫“用手的性行为”。

lines.en: : I can’t believe you didn’t tell me! In vivid detail! How did you even bring yourself to do it with your whole “all sex is bad sex” mentality?
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你居然没告诉我！还得是巨细无遗地告诉我！你是怎么靠着那套“一切性行为都是坏的性行为”的心态说服自己做的啊？

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk8

: You probably want to keep your voice down when Miss Watabe is like, {i}right{/i} there. Unless your goal is landing us in {i}another{/i} support group which, not gonna lie, I don’t really have the time for anymore.
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师{i}就在{/i}旁边的时候，你大概该把声音放小点。除非你的目标是让我们{i}再{/i}进一次互助小组——说实话，我最近真没那个时间了。

lines.en: : Why? Cause you’re too busy with all the hot hand-sex you’re having and not telling me about?
lines.zh: : 为什么？因为你忙着做那些火辣的用手性行为，还不告诉我？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I just didn’t think it was a big deal.
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我只是觉得那没什么大不了的。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk7
: Of course it’s a big deal! That’s a major step for you! You overcame a massive hurdle and you’re treating it like...well...like Sensei treats everything! Don’t become another him!
lines.zh: : 当然是大不了的事！那对你来说是重大的一步！你跨过了一道巨大的坎，却把它当成……好吧……当成 Sensei 对待一切事情的态度！别变成另一个他！

lines.en: : Why? I thought you liked him.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我以为你喜欢他。

lines.en: : Yeah, but not all the sad parts!
lines.zh: : 是啊，但不喜欢他那些伤感的毛病！

lines.en: : But those are like the only parts that exist in the first place.
lines.zh: : 可他本来基本上就只剩那些部分了啊。

lines.en: : So?!
lines.zh: : 那又怎样？！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk9
: Uta, with all due respect, I’m a lot less inclined to do {i}anything{/i} sexual if I need to report back to you afterward. And we both know how inclined I am to begin with, so yeah.
lines.zh: : Uta，恕我直言，如果事后还得向你汇报，我做{i}任何{/i}性相关的事的意愿都会大打折扣。而我们俩都知道我原本的意愿就低得可怜，所以，就是这样。

lines.en: : I’m only probing you for answers because {i}you{/i} brought it up! Which means that, deep down in your stupid Io-brain, there’s some sort of psychological compulsion {i}to{/i} talk about it!
lines.zh: : 我追问你，是因为{i}你自己{/i}提起的！也就是说，在你那颗愚蠢的 Io 大脑深处，有某种心理上的强迫症想要谈论它！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk10
: Oh, shit. You might be right.
lines.zh: : 哦，该死。你也许是对的。

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} right! Which makes every second we spend here at murder practice one second we {i}could{/i} be using for girl talk!
lines.zh: : 我{i}就是{/i}对的！那么，我们在这儿练习谋杀的每一秒，都是本来{i}可以{/i}用来聊女生八卦的一秒！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk11
: Ughh! But I hate girl talk! There’s so much {i}girl{/i} involved!
lines.zh: : 呃啊！可我讨厌女生八卦！那里面的{i}女生{/i}成分也太重了！

lines.en: : Miss Watabe! I need to go have my period in the tea ceremony room with Io! And you’re not legally allowed to ask any follow-up questions about that since it involves periods, I think! Can I have the key?!
lines.zh: : Watabe 老师！我要和 Io 去茶道室来月经了！而且既然涉及月经，我想法律上你是不允许追问任何后续问题的！能把钥匙给我吗？！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk12
: No. Go have it somewhere that isn’t going to get blood all over our culture. And don’t drag Ichimonji into it either when we all know she hates anything even mildly related to girls.
lines.zh: : 不行。去别的地方来，别把我们文化的东西弄得满处是血。还有别把 Ichimonji 也拖下水——我们都知道她讨厌任何哪怕跟女生沾点边的东西。

lines.en: : See? That’s how much I hate girl talk. I’ve barely even spoken to Miss Watabe and she knows.
lines.zh: : 看吧？我有多讨厌女生八卦。我几乎没跟 Watabe 老师说过话，她都知道。

lines.en: : This time’s different! What if I promise not to bleed everywhere?! Can I have the key then?!
lines.zh: : 这次不一样！要是我保证不弄得到处是血呢？！那能把钥匙给我吗？！

lines.en: : If it gets you to shut up, fine. Take it. Tojo should have it. She was the last one to use the room.
lines.zh: : 只要能让你闭嘴，行。拿去吧。Tojo 应该有。她是最后一个用那间屋子的。

lines.en: scene black
: Tsuneyo!
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo！

lines.en: : Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please take your time looking over the menu and let me know-
lines.zh: : 欢迎光临 Tojo 拉面。请慢慢看菜单，需要的话告诉我——

lines.en: : We’re at school, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 我们在学校，剑道公主。

lines.en: : Oh, right. It appears that we are. Here is our takeout menu.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。看起来确实是。这是我们的外带菜单。

lines.en: : You had that in your hakama?!
lines.zh: : 你居然把那个揣在袴里？！

lines.en: : I just want the key!
lines.zh: : 我只想要钥匙！

lines.en: : And I’ll take the butter miso ramen with a side of a gyoza. Thanks.
lines.zh: : 那我要黄油味噌拉面，再加一份饺子。谢了。

lines.en: : Eat later! Gossip now! Come, come, come!
lines.zh: : 晚点再吃！先八卦！来，来，来！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk13
: Do we really need to sit like this? I hate seiza.
lines.zh: : 我们真的得这么坐吗？我讨厌正坐。

lines.en: : I promised Miss Watabe I would respect our culture. And if we are going to be talking about handjobs in here, this is the only way I can currently think of that will do that.
lines.zh: : 我答应过 Watabe 老师要尊重我们的文化。而且既然我们要在这儿聊打飞机的事，这是我现在能想到的唯一合适的方式。

lines.en: : Fine. What do you want to know?
lines.zh: : 行吧。你想知道什么？

lines.en: : Did you hate it? Do you intend to do it again?
lines.zh: : 你讨厌吗？你还打算再做吗？

lines.en: : I did not hate it. But I could also live without ever doing it again and be totally fine.
lines.zh: : 我不讨厌。不过就算这辈子再也不做，我也会过得完全没问题。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk14
: How did it even happen? Like, did he come onto {i}you{/i} or what?
lines.zh: : 到底是怎么发生的？比如，是他主动找上{i}你{/i}的还是怎么？

lines.en: : I am going to plead the fifth here because I don’t want to reveal any more than I already have and it is possible I have hidden even more things from you.
lines.zh: : 我要在这里援引第五修正案，因为我不想透露比已经透露的更多，而且我可能还瞒了你更多的事。

lines.en: : As an attorney, I should inform you that pleading the fifth involves not incriminating yourself and you are already being investigated for aggravated hand-sex.
lines.zh: : 作为一名律师，我得提醒你，援引第五修正案意味着不自我归罪，而你已经因为严重的用手性行为正在被调查了。

lines.en: : Okay. But no one ever Mirandized me, so I think that must count for something.
lines.zh: : 好吧。可从来没人对我宣读过米兰达警告，所以我觉得这总该算点什么。

lines.en: : Is your name Miranda? I don’t think so. Speak, girl. How did it happen?
lines.zh: : 你叫 Miranda 吗？我不这么认为。说吧，姑娘。到底怎么发生的？

lines.en: : Well...it kind of just {i}did.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯……就是那么{i}发生了{/i}。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk15

: He came over to use the bath one day and I just reached around and stroked it while I was washing his back. It was surprisingly natural. And I’m not only saying that because of the years of sexual abuse.
lines.zh: : 有一天他过来泡澡，我在给他擦背的时候就绕过去摸了它。意外地自然。而且我这么说，可不只是因为那些年遭受的性虐待。

lines.en: : You {i}bitch!{/i} I tried to do that once! That was supposed to be {i}my{/i} move!
lines.zh: : 你个{i}贱人{/i}！我也试过一次！那本来该是{i}我的{/i}招数！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk16
: How did you even fail in the first place? Were your arms just not long enough or something?
lines.zh: : 你到底是怎么失手的？难道是你的胳膊不够长还是怎么的？

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk17
: I was interrupted by the ghosts of my past again and decided in that moment that it was more important to shield my naked youth from Sensei than it was to give him a handjob.
lines.zh: 我被过去的幽灵又一次打断了，而在那一刻我认定，把赤裸的青春从 Sensei 面前遮住，比给他打一发更重要。

lines.en: : Do I regret this decision? Yes. But that’s okay because I can now live vicariously through you who somehow had the strength to do what I did not against all odds.
lines.zh: 我后悔这个决定吗？后悔。不过没关系，因为我现在可以借由你来间接体验——你不知怎么就有了我做不到的那种力量，还战胜了一切困难。

lines.en: : Or, you know, you could stop beating around the bush and just do it yourself already.
lines.zh: : 或者，你知道的，你也可以别再拐弯抹角，干脆自己上啊。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk18
: I want to, okay?! It’s just every time I feel like it’s about to happen, it doesn’t! And I don’t have the confidence to take the initiative like you apparently do!
lines.zh: : 我也想啊，好吗？！只是每次我觉得它就要发生了，它就没发生！而且我没有像你显然有的那种主动出击的自信！

lines.en: : Oh, yay. I’m finally beating you at something. I just wish I wasn’t because that makes me sad.
lines.zh: : 哦，好耶。我总算在某一件事上赢你了。我只希望我没有，因为那让我很伤心。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk19
: So, like...can you tell me more? Maybe?
lines.zh: : 那么，比如……你能再多说点吗？也许？

lines.en: : More, like...like what? Do you want me to, like...make hand gestures or something? Because you'll need to get me a stuffed bear for that. The therapist always used a bear..
lines.zh: 多一点，比如……比如什么？你想让我……比如……做手势什么的吗？因为那样你得给我弄只毛绒熊。治疗师一直用熊的……

lines.en: : You said you think doing that made Sensei like you more? Like you jumped in the rankings. Right? That’s what you said, isn’t it? How?
lines.zh: : 你说你觉得那么做让 Sensei 更喜欢你了？比如你在排行榜上跳了名次。对吧？你是这么说的吧？怎么做到的？

lines.en: : I mean, I don’t know for {i}sure.{/i} But we both know Sensei is a pervert and I am the complete opposite of that. So I think finally being {i}able{/i} to do that for him can’t be a strike against me, right?
lines.zh: : 我是说，我也不{i}确定{/i}。不过我们都知道 Sensei 是个变态，而我恰恰相反。所以我觉得，终于{i}能够{/i}为他做那件事，总不该是我的减分项吧？

lines.en: : You shouldn’t just do it for {i}him,{/i} though! You need to want it yourself too or you’re just treating yourself like an object again! You’re not supposed to do that!
lines.zh: : 可你不该只为了{i}他{/i}而做！你自己也得想要，否则你又是在把自己当物件！你不该那么做的！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk20
: Well...that’s how it sounds, sure. But I actually {i}did{/i} like it, I think. And it wasn’t really forcing myself either.
lines.zh: : 嗯……听上去确实是那样。不过我其实{i}确实{/i}喜欢，我想。而且也不算强迫自己。

lines.en: : I just felt like it was a good way for us to connect in that moment and I tried seeing it as an act of intimacy rather than...well, what it’s been every other time ever.
lines.zh: 我只是觉得那在当时是我们建立连接的好方式，我试着把它当成一种亲密行为，而不是……好吧，不是它以往每一次的那种东西。

lines.en: : It was...nice. He wasn’t weird about it. {i}I{/i} wasn’t weird about it. And it didn’t keep me up that night. I got home, got dressed, took my meds, and went to bed like normal.
lines.zh: : 那很……美好。他没有表现得很怪。{i}我{/i}也没有表现得很怪。而且那天晚上它没让我失眠。我回到家，换好衣服，吃了药，然后像平常一样上床睡觉。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk21
: So, like...maybe I {i}can-{/i}
lines.zh: : 那么，比如……也许我{i}也行{/i}——

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk22
: You are crying.
lines.zh: : 你在哭。

lines.en: : I am crying.
lines.zh: : 我在哭。

lines.en: : Stop that.
lines.zh: : 别哭了。

lines.en: : No.
: You are disrespecting our culture. We’re not supposed to show emotions in public.
lines.zh: : 你在亵渎我们的文化。我们不该在公开场合流露情绪。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk23
: I’m just proud of you, okay?! You had a super massive major moment behind the scenes and didn’t even tell me about it! I was worried this day wouldn’t {i}ever{/i} come!
lines.zh: : 我只是为你骄傲，好吗？！你在背地里经历了那么超级重大的一刻，居然都没告诉我！我还担心这一天{i}永远{/i}都不会来呢！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk24
: Let alone before it came for {i}me!{/i} I’m the one who actually wants it! And when I say {i}want{/i} it, Io, I mean {i}badly!{/i}
lines.zh: 更别说它还比{i}我的{/i}先来了！我才是真正想要的那个人！而且我说{i}想要{/i}的时候，Io，意思是{i}想得要命{/i}！

lines.en: : Yes, Uta. I am aware of how badly you want it. You make no effort to conceal that from me despite how you probably should.
lines.zh: : 是，Uta。我知道你有多想要。你根本不对我掩饰这一点，尽管你大概该掩饰一下。

lines.en: : It’s mostly pride though, I swear! Furious jealousy is probably only, like...15%% of the tears!
lines.zh: : 不过主要还是骄傲，我发誓！暴怒的嫉妒大概只占这些眼泪的……15%！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk25
: You’re doing that to yourself, though, Uta.
lines.zh: : 可那是你自己造成的啊，Uta。

lines.en: : Like, you might think girls like the blonde one or the {i}other{/i} blonde one who went black for a little but is now blonde again are your biggest obstacles. But the real obstacle is {i}you,{/i} Uta.
lines.zh: : 就好比，你可能觉得那个金发女孩、或者{i}另一个{/i}金发女孩——她黑了一阵子，现在又金回来了——是你最大的障碍。但真正的障碍是{i}你自己{/i}，Uta。

lines.en: : Please remember our classmates’ names. It’s been years, Io.
lines.zh: : 拜托记住同学的名字吧。都这么多年了，Io。

lines.en: : You’re right. It {i}has{/i} been years. Years of you wanting something and never taking it despite it being {i}right{/i} there within your reach.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。{i}确实{/i}这么多年了。这么多年你一直想要某样东西却从不伸手去拿，尽管它{i}就在{/i}你触手可及的地方。

lines.en: : I don’t like watching you suffer, Uta. But I like it even less when it’s a choice you’re actively making.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢看你受苦，Uta。但如果是你自己主动选择的，我更不喜欢。

lines.en: : Just...forget everyone else. Forget the nerves. Forget whatever it is that’s holding you back because, like it or not, you’re going to get left behind if you keep this up.
lines.zh: 就……忘掉其他所有人。忘掉紧张。忘掉那个拖住你的东西，因为不管你愿不愿意，你再这样下去就会被落下。

lines.en: : Left behind?...
lines.zh: : 被落下？……

lines.en: : What do you mean?...
lines.zh: : 你是什么意思？……

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk26
: When you moved here...and reinvented yourself...why did you do that?
lines.zh: : 你搬来这儿的时候……还重塑了自己……为什么要那么做？

lines.en: : Because I...
lines.zh: : 因为我……

lines.en: : I wanted to start over. As someone completely new. Someone perfect and...and pure. The complete opposite of who I {i}really{/i} am.
lines.zh: 我想重新开始。作为一个全新的人。一个完美的、而且……而且纯洁的人。和我{i}真正{/i}的样子完全相反。

lines.en: : You wanted to be someone who stands out, right?
lines.zh: : 你想成为一个出众的人，对吧？

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk27
: And do you think you’re doing that now?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得你现在做到了吗？

lines.en: : Standing out?
lines.zh: : 出众？

lines.en: : Or do you think, somewhere along the lines, it got harder playing pretend and you’ve settled back into what’s safe?
lines.zh: 还是你觉得，不知从什么时候起，演戏变难了，于是你又退回了那个安全的自己？

lines.en: : I’m just scared, Io...
lines.zh: : 我只是害怕，Io……

lines.en: : Of what? You’re already in love and that’s the scariest thing of all.
lines.zh: : 怕什么？你已经坠入爱河了，而那才是最可怕的事。

lines.en: : I know...I know. It’s just, like...
lines.zh: : 我知道……我知道。只是，比如……

lines.en: : Like, I don’t want this to sound like I don’t trust Sensei or that I think he’d, like...just {i}use{/i} me or anything...but when I’ve taken initiative in the past, it’s...
lines.zh: 比如，我不想让这话听起来像我不信任 Sensei，或者觉得他会……只是{i}利用{/i}我之类的……可是过去当我主动出击的时候，它……

lines.en: : It’s only made things worse. So I...it’s just...harder to do that now, I think.
lines.zh: : 只会让事情变得更糟。所以我……只是……现在要那么做更难了，我想。

lines.en: : Which, of course, just makes me spiral back into remembering how gross I am for putting myself out there the way I did and how nobody would {i}want{/i} to be with me in the first place and-
lines.zh: 当然，这又让我螺旋着回想起了我那么把自己送出去有多恶心，以及本来就没谁会{i}想要{/i}跟我在一起，然后——

lines.en: : Stop {i}that{/i} too. If I’m not allowed to call myself damaged goods despite actually {i}being{/i} damaged goods, I’m not going to let some horny virgin steal all of my valor.
lines.zh: : {i}那个{/i}也停下。就算我真的{i}是{/i}残次品，我都不允许自己叫自己残次品，那我就更不会让某个发骚的处女把我全部的勇气偷走。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Io. Please don’t let me feeling sorry for myself take away from how proud I am of you.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Io。请别让我自怨自艾，夺走了我为你骄傲的这份心情。

lines.en: : Oh, no. I implore you — please {i}do{/i} take away from that. I hate being the center of attention and would much rather continue encouraging you to become wiener cousins with me.
lines.zh: 哦，不。我恳求你——请{i}尽管{/i}夺走吧。我讨厌成为关注的中心，我更愿意继续鼓励你和我一起成为鸡巴表亲。

lines.en: : I think it’s “coochie cousins” when you’re talking about girls.
lines.zh: : 我觉得说到女生的时候，应该叫“小穴表亲”。

lines.en: : Right, well I’m sure you understand why I didn’t say that.
lines.zh: : 对，嗯，我相信你明白我为什么没说那个。

lines.en: : I think I’m just going to die a virgin. I’m not sure I even {i}want{/i} to have sex anymore if Sensei’s going to compare me to fucking...{i}Niki.{/i}
lines.zh: 我想我大概要当一辈子处女了。如果 Sensei 会拿我去跟那个什么……{i}Niki{/i}比较，我连自己还想不{i}想要{/i}做爱都不确定了。

lines.en: : You totally still want to have sex.
lines.zh: : 你绝对还是想要做爱的。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk28
: I want all the sex ever. I just always figured I’d be saying that in the missionary position rather than seiza.
lines.zh: : 我想要这世上所有的性。只不过我一直以为自己会是在传教士体位里说这句话，而不是正坐。

lines.en: : Wow, you really are a pervert if {i}that’s{/i} the position that comes to mind. Deplorable. Disgraceful, even.
lines.zh: : 哇，如果{i}那个{/i}是你第一反应想到的体位，那你可真是个变态。可耻。简直丢人。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk29
: You said there was more you were hiding from me earlier.
lines.zh: : 你刚才说你还瞒了我更多的事。

lines.en: : No I didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我没说过。

lines.en: : What did you mean by that?
lines.zh: : 那你那话是什么意思？

lines.en: : I didn’t mean anything by it because I never said that. The hormones are just going to your head again.
lines.zh: : 我没什么意思，因为我根本没说过那句话。荷尔蒙又冲上你的头了。

lines.en: : There is a history of that happening in this room for me. But still, I-
lines.zh: : 我在这个屋子里确实有过这种前科。不过我还是——

lines.en: : Listen, Uta — I’ve already talked more openly about sex today than I have in a long time. And I’d like to call it quits here if that’s okay. But I will leave you with these parting words.
lines.zh: 听着，Uta——我今天谈论性的坦白程度已经是很久以来最高的一次了。如果可以的话，我想就此打住。不过最后我送你这几句话。

lines.en: : I think you are currently on pace to be the last girl to ever have sex with Sensei. And, if that happens, I’m sorry, but I think I’ll just be too cool to be your friend at that point.
lines.zh: 我觉得照目前的速度，你正朝着成为最后一个和 Sensei 上床的女孩前进。而如果真到了那一步，抱歉，我想我到时候会酷到没法和你做朋友了。

lines.en: : Are you going to leave me if I don’t have sex with him?
lines.zh: : 如果我不跟他上床，你就要离开我吗？

lines.en: : Yeah, I think you’re forcing my hand here.
lines.zh: : 是啊，我觉得你这是在逼我。

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk30
: Io!
lines.zh: : Io！

lines.en: : Now, if you’ll please excuse me, I’m going to go do something about all of the calluses on my hands so I can be better at hand-sex in the future. Good talk!
lines.zh: 那么，请恕我失陪，我要去处理一下手上那些茧，好让我以后更擅长用手的性行为。聊得很愉快！

lines.en: scene utaioarcherytalk31
: No! {i}Bad{/i} talk! I didn’t get nearly enough detail about the actual handjob! All I got was pain and envy!
lines.zh: : 不！聊得一点也{i}不愉快{/i}！关于那次打飞机本身我几乎没得到任何细节！我得到的只有痛苦和嫉妒！

lines.en: : Has the pride worn off then?
lines.zh: : 那骄傲劲儿过去了？

lines.en: : Could your hand fit around the whole thing or was there still some real estate left?! Where in the bathhouse did it happen?! What were you wearing?!
lines.zh: 你的手能整个握住吗，还是说还有剩余的面积？！是在澡堂的什么地方发生的？！你当时穿的什么？！

lines.en: : Do you think Tsuneyo’s still out there? I’m kind of hungry.
lines.zh: : 你觉得 Tsuneyo 还在外面吗？我有点饿了。

lines.en: scene black
: This damn tea ceremony room is ruining my life!
lines.zh: : 这该死的茶道室在毁我的人生！

lines.en: : See you at the dorm, Uta! You clearly need some time to yourself!
lines.zh: : 宿舍见，Uta！你显然需要点独处的时间！

lines.en: : AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！！！！

lines.en: The air had changed in Kumon-mi lately.
lines.zh: 最近，Kumon-mi 的空气变了。

lines.en: And, all around it, everything else was beginning to change too.
lines.zh: 而在它周围，其他一切也开始改变。
